final_candidates.decision_summary: Highest combined PLM plausibility (1.0) and structure compatibility (0.91) at a surface-exposed head-domain residue. Charge reversal may modulate receptor-binding surface without destabilizing the fold.

Conservative Phe-to-Tyr swap with perfect PLM score, good structure delta, and the only non-trivial evolutionary tolerance among candidates. Unlikely to compromise viability while subtly altering the head surface.

Strong PLM plausibility (0.855) and the best structure compatibility delta (-0.31); gained positive charge on an exposed β-strand could enhance receptor engagement. Evolutionary signal is uninformative due to minimal MSA coverage.

stop_reason.detail: Evidence across PLM, structure, MSA, and annotation tools is converged and the direct phenotype predictor is unavailable; further calls would not alter the Top-3.
